# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 17 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 34 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_017_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 17

**1** Jesus said: "I will give you what no eye has seen and what no ear has heard and what no hand has touched and what has never arisen in the human heart."

---

**Translation Notes (LOGOS):**
- Four members: sight, hearing, touch, thought — all channels of human experience excluded
- "What no eye has seen" — the visible realm transcended
- "What no ear has heard" — the audible realm transcended
- "What no hand has touched" — the tactile realm transcended (unique to Thomas over Paul)
- "Never arisen in the human heart" — the imaginative/intellectual realm transcended
- The gift Jesus promises exceeds the entirety of possible human experience
- "I will give" — first person; Jesus is the agent of this transcendent gift
